claims.claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through L0 route-policy dispatch and multi-agent orchestration contracts.
Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions that connected reusable platform commercialization with enterprise workflow priorities.
Strengthened production trust with audit-grade observability for regulated AI workflows, combining evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
Accelerated the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks by standardizing managed workflow orchestration, replayable runtime design, and exit disposition governance.
Architected high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across cloud data infrastructure, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a scalable operating model.
